comment: Schema documents of an AuditCatalogue and whether the policy takes them (kits/go/audit/policy.go, kits/rust/sluis-audit/src/policy.rs): the keywords the generator makes, references to the shared definitions only, patterns RE2 and the Rust regex crate read alike, bounded depth and size. Go and Rust read this file and must agree on every case. Generated by hand from a script; edit the cases here, not the shapes. The `matches` list holds accepted patterns with strings each engine must match or refuse the same way.
